# Runbook workflows

Runbooks workflows that content packages list. Source Control Repos does not sync them: the Content Package Manager extension writes each folder when it exports a package and creates or updates the workflow with that ID when it syncs one. They need the Runbooks content.

| Workflow | ID | Description | Steps | Step plugins |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prepare Linux app host | [SWF-69r5mmdb](SWF-69r5mmdb/README.md) | Checks a Linux VM against the limits in a config file from File Archives, creates the application's service account and directories, and sets up log retention and a host profile, every step reading the same config file. | 3 | [Create Linux App Account](../plugins/OHK-4etpeg05/), [Check Linux App Host](../plugins/OHK-fct1gybi/), [Configure Linux App Host](../plugins/OHK-o30l8kjn/) |
| Prepare Windows app host | [SWF-7s01lyyk](SWF-7s01lyyk/README.md) | Checks a Windows VM against the limits in a config file from File Archives, creates the application's folders and operators group, and records its settings, a log clean-up task and an event, every step reading the same config file. | 3 | [Create Windows App Folders](../plugins/OHK-7fxxufkt/), [Configure Windows App Host](../plugins/OHK-lkmy7ij9/), [Check Windows App Host](../plugins/OHK-ys68wsmf/) |
